name: Clear stuck updates (apt)
description: Fixes "could not get lock" errors: waits for any update already running, clears locks left by a crashed update, and finishes half-installed packages.
args:
for f in /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend /var/lib/dpkg/lock /var/lib/apt/lists/lock /var/cache/apt/archives/lock; do
  p=$(fuser "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' '); if [ -n "$p" ]; then echo "LOCK_HELD: $f by $(ps -o comm= -p $p | tr '\n' ' ')"; held=1; fi
done
if [ -n "$held" ]; then echo "Waiting up to 10 minutes for the running update to finish..."; for i in $(seq 1 60); do fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1 || break; sleep 10; done; fi
if fuser /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo STILL_BUSY; exit 1; fi
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive dpkg --configure -a && echo PACKAGES_FINISHED

friendly.title: Package locks

name: Turn off broken software sources (apt)
description: Moves the extra source files that fail (never the system's main sources) into a backup folder, so updates work again.
args:
out=$(LC_ALL=C apt-get update 2>&1); bk=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/disabled-by-mendkit; n=0
for host in $(echo "$out" | grep -E "does not have a Release file|NO_PUBKEY|EXPKEYSIG|404 +Not Found|is not signed" -B2 | grep -oE "https?://[^ ]+" | sed -E 's#https?://([^/]+)(/[^ ]*)?#\1\2#' | cut -d/ -f1-3 | sort -u); do
  for f in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    if grep -q "$host" "$f"; then mkdir -p "$bk"; mv "$f" "$bk/" && echo "SET_ASIDE: $(basename "$f")" && n=$((n+1)); fi; done; done
echo "TOTAL: $n"; apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -3

description: Shows the GRUB menu for 5 seconds at every start, so an older kernel or Windows can be chosen. The old settings file is kept as grub.mendkit-backup.
args:
f=/etc/default/grub; [ -e "$f" ] || { echo NO_GRUB; exit 0; }; cp -n "$f" "$f.mendkit-backup"
sed -i -E 's/^#?GRUB_TIMEOUT_STYLE=.*/GRUB_TIMEOUT_STYLE=menu/; s/^#?GRUB_TIMEOUT=.*/GRUB_TIMEOUT=5/' "$f"; grep -q '^GRUB_TIMEOUT_STYLE' "$f" || echo 'GRUB_TIMEOUT_STYLE=menu' >> "$f"
grep -q '^GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER' "$f" || echo 'GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=false' >> "$f"
if command -v update-grub >/dev/null; then update-grub; elif [ -d /boot/grub2 ]; then grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg; else grub-mkconfig -o /boot/grub/grub.cfg; fi

friendly.title: Startup menu
friendly.ok: The startup menu now shows for 5 seconds at every start.

name: Rebuild the startup files (initramfs)
description: Rebuilds the small startup image each kernel loads first. Fixes some "cannot start" problems after an interrupted update.
args: if command -v update-initramfs >/dev/null; then update-initramfs -u -k all; elif command -v dracut >/dev/null; then dracut -f --regenerate-all; elif command -v mkinitcpio >/dev/null; then mkinitcpio -P; else echo NO_TOOL; fi

name: Use X11 instead of Wayland (GNOME)
description: Makes the GNOME sign-in screen start the older X11 session. Fixes some screen sharing, remote support and NVIDIA problems.
args:
f=/etc/gdm3/custom.conf; [ -e $f ] || f=/etc/gdm/custom.conf; [ -e $f ] || { echo NOT_GDM; exit 0; }; cp -n $f $f.mendkit-backup
if grep -q '^#\?WaylandEnable' $f; then sed -i -E 's/^#?WaylandEnable=.*/WaylandEnable=false/' $f; else sed -i '/^\[daemon\]/a WaylandEnable=false' $f; fi; grep WaylandEnable $f

name: Reset the sound system completely
description: Stops PipeWire, clears its saved device choices (kept as a backup) and starts it fresh. Fixes missing outputs, wrong default device and crackling.
args:
systemctl --user stop wireplumber pipewire-pulse pipewire pipewire.socket pipewire-pulse.socket 2>/dev/null
for d in "$HOME/.local/state/wireplumber" "$HOME/.config/pulse"; do [ -e "$d" ] && mv "$d" "$d.mendkit-backup-$(date +%s)" && echo "RESET: $d"; done
systemctl --user start pipewire.socket pipewire-pulse.socket pipewire pipewire-pulse wireplumber 2>/dev/null || pulseaudio --start; sleep 2; pactl info 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Server Name|Default Sink"

friendly.title: Sound system
friendly.ok: The sound system was reset. Choose the speakers or headphones again in Sound settings.
friendly.problem: The sound system could not be reset.

name: Install HP printer drivers
description: Installs HPLIP, HP's own Linux drivers and setup tool, for HP printers and scanners that do not work on their own.
args:
pm_install(){ if command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y "$@"; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null; then dnf install -y "$@"; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null; then pacman -S --noconfirm --needed "$@"; elif command -v zypper >/dev/null; then zypper --non-interactive install "$@"; else echo NO_PACKAGE_MANAGER; return 1; fi; }
pm_install hplip || true; command -v apt-get >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y hplip-gui >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v hp-setup >/dev/null && echo HPLIP_READY

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then pm_install sane-utils sane-airscan; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null; then pm_install sane-backends sane-airscan; else pm_install sane sane-airscan; fi; scanimage -L

name: Hardware error scan
description: Searches this boot's system log for drive read errors, USB devices dropping out, overheating slowdowns, and memory or processor errors.
args:
j=$(journalctl -k -b --no-pager 2>/dev/null)
c(){ n=$(echo "$j" | grep -ciE "$2"); echo "$1: $n"; }
c DRIVE_ERRORS "I/O error|ata[0-9.]+: (exception|failed command)|blk_update_request|critical medium error|nvme.*(timeout|reset)"
c USB_RESETS "usb .*reset|usb .*disconnect.*device number|over-current"
c THERMAL "temperature above threshold|cpu clock throttled|thermal.*critical"
c MEMORY_CPU "mce:|machine check|EDAC.*error|corrected error"
c GPU "gpu hang|ring.*timeout|amdgpu.*error|nouveau.*error|i915.*error|NVRM: Xid"
echo; echo "$j" | grep -iE "I/O error|over-current|throttled|mce:|gpu hang|Xid" | tail -15

friendly.title: Hardware errors
friendly.ok: This boot's hardware messages were checked.
friendly.problem: Hardware error scan did not work.

USB devices keep dropping out: a loose cable, failing hub or a device drawing too much power.
The processor slowed down because it got too hot. Clean the fans and vents.
The processor or memory reported hardware errors. Test the memory with Memtest86+ from the ISO Library.
The graphics driver reported errors. Update or change the graphics driver (see "Devices without a driver").
No drive, memory or processor errors since this start.

name: Security checkup
description: Checks the firewall, automatic security updates, remote login (SSH), who has administrator rights, disk encryption and which programs accept network connections.
args:
if command -v ufw >/dev/null; then echo "FIREWALL: $(ufw status | head -1)"; elif command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null; then echo "FIREWALL: firewalld $(firewall-cmd --state 2>&1)"; else echo "FIREWALL: none installed"; fi
if [ -e /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades ] && grep -q 'Unattended-Upgrade "1"' /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades; then echo "AUTO_UPDATES: on"; elif systemctl is-enabled dnf-automatic.timer dnf5-automatic.timer 2>/dev/null | grep -q enabled; then echo "AUTO_UPDATES: on"; elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null || command -v dnf >/dev/null; then echo "AUTO_UPDATES: off"; else echo "AUTO_UPDATES: not available"; fi
if systemctl is-active -q ssh sshd 2>/dev/null; then echo "SSH: running, password login $(sshd -T 2>/dev/null | awk '/^passwordauthentication/{print $2}')"; else echo "SSH: off"; fi
echo "ADMINS: $(getent group sudo wheel | cut -d: -f4 | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')"
lsblk -o TYPE | grep -q crypt && echo "ENCRYPTION: on" || echo "ENCRYPTION: off"
echo "LISTENING:"; ss -tulpnH 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "127\.0\.0|\[::1\]|%lo" | awk '{print "  " $1, $5, $7}' | head -20

friendly.title: Security
friendly.problem: Security checkup did not work.

notes.message: The firewall is off. Run "Turn on the firewall".
Security updates are not installed automatically. Run "Turn on automatic security updates".
Remote login (SSH) is on and accepts passwords. If nobody logs in remotely, turn it off: sudo systemctl disable --now ssh
The drive is not encrypted, so anyone with the computer can read its files. Encryption can only be turned on by reinstalling, with "Encrypt the disk" ticked.
The firewall is on.

name: Turn on the firewall
description: Turns on the firewall, blocking incoming connections but not outgoing ones. Remote login (SSH) stays allowed if it is in use.
args:
if command -v ufw >/dev/null; then systemctl is-active -q ssh sshd && ufw allow OpenSSH; ufw default deny incoming; ufw default allow outgoing; ufw --force enable; ufw status
elif command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null || command -v dnf >/dev/null; then command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null || dnf install -y firewalld; systemctl enable --now firewalld; firewall-cmd --state
elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ufw && ufw default deny incoming && ufw --force enable && ufw status
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null; then pacman -S --noconfirm --needed ufw && systemctl enable --now ufw && ufw --force enable; fi

friendly.title: Firewall
friendly.problem: The firewall could not be turned on.

name: Turn on automatic security updates
description: Installs security updates automatically every day (apt) or every day with dnf-automatic (Fedora).
args:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y unattended-upgrades && printf 'APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";\nAPT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "1";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades && systemctl enable --now unattended-upgrades && echo ON
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null; then (dnf install -y dnf-automatic || dnf install -y dnf5-plugin-automatic); f=/etc/dnf/automatic.conf; [ -e $f ] || { [ -e /usr/share/dnf5/dnf5-plugins/automatic.conf ] && cp /usr/share/dnf5/dnf5-plugins/automatic.conf $f; }
 [ -e $f ] && sed -i -E 's/^upgrade_type *=.*/upgrade_type = security/; s/^apply_updates *=.*/apply_updates = yes/' $f; systemctl enable --now dnf-automatic.timer 2>/dev/null || systemctl enable --now dnf5-automatic.timer; echo ON
else echo NOT_AVAILABLE; fi

elif [ "$ID" = fedora ]; then echo "CURRENT_FEDORA: $VERSION_ID"
else echo "Check the distribution's website for upgrades."; fi
